title: tcp_mgm Module
content_markdown: This module provides optional, SQL-based support for fine-grained management of all TCP connections taking place on OpenSIPS.
overview: This module provides optional, SQL-based support for fine-grained management of all TCP connections taking place on OpenSIPS.

dependencies_required.name: db_xxx
dependencies_required.reason: At least one SQL database module must be loaded

exported_parameters.name: db_url
exported_parameters.description: Mandatory URL to the SQL database.

exported_parameters.name: db_table
exported_parameters.description: The name of the table holding the TCP paths (rules).

exported_parameters.name: [column-name]_col
exported_parameters.description: Use a different name for column "column-name".

exported_mi_functions.name: tcp_mgm:reload
exported_mi_functions.description: Replaces obsolete MI command: _tcp\_reload_. Reload all TCP paths from the _tcp\_mgm_ table without disrupting ongoing traffic. Note that the reloaded rules will NOT immediately apply to existing TCP connections, rather only to newly established ones.

examples.code:
\# reload all TCP paths
$ opensips-cli -x mi tcp\_mgm:reload
$ "OK"

configuration_examples.title: Setting the `db_url` parameter
configuration_examples.description: Mandatory URL to the SQL database.

configuration_examples.title: Setting the `db_table` parameter
configuration_examples.description: The name of the table holding the TCP paths (rules). Default value is "tcp_mgm".

configuration_examples.title: Setting the `[column-name]_col` parameter
configuration_examples.description: Use a different name for column "column-name".
